questions.title: Epithelium's main physiological function
questions.question: What is the main physiological function of epithelial tissue?

explanations.A: Incorrect. Contraction and movement are the defining physiological role of muscle tissue, not epithelium.
explanations.B: Correct. Of the four basic tissue types, epithelium's defining physiological job is absorption and secretion. It does this by lining surfaces and cavities, and by lining or forming glands, to move substances across a barrier in either direction. Intestinal absorption and glandular secretion are the two clearest worked examples of this shared function.
explanations.C: Incorrect. Protection and mechanical support are chiefly connective tissue's role, achieved through its abundant extracellular matrix.
explanations.D: Incorrect. Conducting electrical impulses is the defining role of nervous tissue, not epithelium.

questions.learning_objective: Name absorption and secretion as epithelium's main physiological function.
